_about: Public-domain P. T. Forsyth (Peter Taylor Forsyth, 1848-1921, Congregationalist, Hackney College) for the Word Hoard: 24 books and addresses from Internet Archive scans, 1885-1918, among them The Person and Place of Jesus Christ, The Cruciality of the Cross, The Work of Christ, Positive Preaching and the Modern Mind, The Justification of God, The Principle of Authority, The Soul of Prayer and Lectures on the Church and the Sacraments. CCEL's two Forsyth texts name no print source and are held as alternates. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
